title: 04_fitpulse_terms
summary: FitPulse is a fitness app that gathers your workout, heart rate, sleep, and medical activity data and can share it in bulk with other companies. It forces you to settle any disputes through binding arbitration and you can’t join a class action. If you cancel a yearly plan, you’ll lose 25% of the remaining months as a fee, and the company can change the rules anytime, which you accept by continuing to use the app. You can delete your personal account, but the overall statistics made from your data will stay.
keyPoints: FitPulse collects workout logs, heart rate, sleep, and medical activity data.
Aggregated data is shared with analytics providers and research partners.
You must agree to binding arbitration and cannot join a class action lawsuit.
Canceling an annual plan keeps 25% of the remaining months as a fee.
FitPulse can change its terms at any time; continued use means you accept the new terms.
You can delete your account, but aggregated statistics derived from your data remain.

risks.clauseQuote: By using FitPulse you agree that any dispute shall be resolved by binding arbitration and you waive the right to a jury trial or to join a class action.
risks.explanation: If you have a problem, you must settle it through arbitration and can’t sue in court or join a group lawsuit.

risks.clauseQuote: If you cancel your annual plan we keep 25% of the remaining months as an administrative fee.
risks.explanation: When you stop a yearly subscription, the company still keeps a quarter of the money left on the plan.

risks.clauseQuote: FitPulse is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. To the maximum extent permitted by law FitPulse is not liable for decisions you make based on your workout data.
risks.explanation: They say they aren’t responsible if you make health decisions based on the app’s data.

risks.clauseQuote: FitPulse collects your workout logs, heart rate data, sleep data and, if you connect a health account, your medical-activity records. This data is shared with our analytics provider and with research partners in aggregated form.
risks.explanation: Your personal health info is given to other companies for analysis and research, though they combine it with data from many users.

risks.clauseQuote: We may update these terms at any time. Your continued use after the update constitutes acceptance.
risks.explanation: The company can change the rules whenever it wants, and if you keep using the app you automatically agree to the new rules.

risks.clauseQuote: You can delete your account at any time from settings, but aggregated statistics derived from your data cannot be removed.
risks.explanation: You can erase your personal account, but the overall summary data made from your info will stay.
